entries.title: Fixed Splayed Foot and Open Tapered Nozzle Fire Monitor
entries.description: One newly authored complete portable ground fire-monitor static exterior. Four full splayed arms end in separate flat ground shoes around one low integral two-cheek fork. A single continuous thick hollow feed body rises from a real open rear collar through two bends into a long inclined tapered nozzle with a genuine open tip. Independent fixed lateral trunnions join the tube wall to both full fork cheeks without crossing the bore. A whole three-spoke open side handwheel, opposite full retaining cap and one continuous rearward U handle complete the assembly. Every shape and coordinate is newly authored; no old hose reel, parked hose nozzle, hydrant or single elbow-pipe mesh is imported, extracted, scaled or renamed. The complete ground fork/trunnioned returning body/forward nozzle/control relation is distinct from an elbow on display pedestals or a coiled hose storage stand. One prop zero scenes, four opaque constant PBR roles, metres, Z up and true horizontal-envelope-centred ground datum. Empty fixed illustrative appearance only: no water or foam, firefighting or crowd-control effect, pressure or flow capacity, sealed passage, coupling compatibility, aiming/elevation movement, recoil restraint, stability, operation, manufacturing or safety certification. This is not real equipment design or use guidance. Rigging, animation and interaction are not made or verified.

entries.title: Fixed Deep Mast and Twin Wing Hydrofoil Board
entries.description: One newly authored complete static hydrofoil-board-style exterior displayed upside down on its own three broad deck-pad appearances. A whole thick rounded-nose board connects through an underside mount to one full deep tapered mast. The mast meets a long complete longitudinal fuselage carrying one broad swept front wing and an independently complete smaller rear stabilizer wing, with genuine clear air between board, wings and the two separated wing roots. All silhouettes and mesh coordinates newly authored, no old board, aircraft wing or propulsion apparatus imported. Unlike the old windsurf whole rig, this has no above-deck sail, wishbone or foot straps and is not a surfboard with its short rear fin enlarged: the deep mast and two separated transverse wings on one fuselage define the integrated assembly. Unlike the handheld diving device, there is no propeller, motor shell, shroud or handgrip. One whole prop zero scenes, four opaque PBR roles, metres, Z up and complete envelope horizontal centre on finite deck-pad faces. Invented game-art dimensions and blunt closed illustrative wing sections only, not a real hydrodynamic design. No water, rider, buoyancy, lift, stability, propulsion, power, control, speed, strength, fit, mounting compatibility, manufacturing or sport/safety performance. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
